For the generator with diffusion term ∂yy and reset term β[f(x,0)-f(x,y)], I independently solved the stationary moment recursion in descending Y-power at each degree and used the exact resolvent (pI-Q)^-1, with Q upper triangular with diagonal (-2,-β-1,-β) and adjacent entries (2β,β). Centering removes the constant diffusion term. The reverse ordered covariance equals Aβ exp(-βt) by conditioning on Y0. Subtracting its resolvent gives the two positive products of resolvents stated in the finding; their causal convolutions are strictly positive for every t>0 and never require taking differences of coincident decay rates. Setting p=0 and dividing by Aβ, symbolic reduction gave the stated rational area, derivative and value at the unique positive root of 31β²+14β-8. The derivative is positive before and negative after that root. The area uses dimensionless lag, so the physical-time area ratio is divided by the trap relaxation rate.
